services.name: Stand Up Paddle Board
services.desc: Paddleboarding was invented in the 90’s by big wave surfers that were looking for a way to have fun when their weren’t any waves, but some will argue that it really started well before then by native tribes to navigate rivers. Either way we are happy to be able to offer such a fun activity here at Buena Vista Watersports! Each of our paddleboarding lessons starts off with a quick bit of instruction that is sure to get even the most inexperienced paddlers up and moving on the water in no time. Both the experienced and novice paddlers alike are sure to have fun with a paddleboard rental here on beautiful Lake

services.name: Kayaks
services.desc: Orlando has no shortage of places to go kayaking, but very few are in water that is as clean and safe as our private spring-fed lake. Our property is located on Lake Bryan, which is only minutes from all of the attractions like Disney, Universal Studios and Seaworld. If you’re staying at one of the resorts on International Drive then we are easily the closest and best option for you to get on the water for a paddle. Never been kayaking before? You have nothing to worry about! Our kayaks are super stable and our qualified instructors will make sure that you know everything there is to know about paddling here. services.name: Pontoon
services.desc: Our pontoon rental is a great option to be on the water and enjoy the serenity of Lake Bryan. You are the captain on this boat! Cruise your family on the calm waters and keep your eyes peeled for the wildlife including otters, bald eagles, herons and ospreys! Ask our Receptionist for a pamphlet of the birds you are likely to spot! Bass Fishing is another activity that is great on the pontoon! Many guests have caught bass as large as 12lbs! Please note that the lake is catch & release only. Buena Vista Watersports does not include poles or bait, but you are welcome to bring your own. Coolers & Picnics are welcome on this boat.
